title: Deterministic, Self-Healing Browser Automation (RPA 2.0)
oneLiner: Browser Use enables AI agents to operate a real browser (click, type, navigate) for web tasks that lack APIs, with Workflow Use providing deterministic fallbacks if a step fails.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: Browser Use enables AI agents to operate a real browser (click, type, navigate) for web tasks that lack APIs, with Workflow Use providing deterministic fallbacks if a step fails.
steps: Define a natural language task (e.g., "Log in and download the monthly report")
Review the agent's step-by-step browser actions.
configSnippet: "Navigate to <URL>, click the 'Download' button, and save the file to the local directory."
limitations: Can be slow and error-prone on highly dynamic or CAPTCHA-protected websites
requires careful handling of asynchronous page loads.
